Model download requires internet, recording and note processing are completely offline, and no sharing of meeting content is allowed.
The test report should include character error rate and word error rate and transcription latency, and should not only mention successful processing.
Today's discussion is limited to these acceptance requirements. System audio capture has not been completed. The release date of the new version has not been determined.
Finally confirm that public release has not yet been approved, 林悦 is to submit the test report on Thursday.
